decisions.reason: As a homepage-featured product close to the firm's traditional candle-arch craft, it carries visible commitment and fit with the core assortment, so management is likely to continue it and interpret any weakness as seasonal.
This pyramid sits very near the firm's established business and was promoted prominently, so sunk design and marketing effort plus strong strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely.

Although the electronic music box is more distant from the traditional range, the firm publicly backed it on the home page and built a broader product family around it, which supports escalation of commitment.

The dedicated page and explicit second edition signal additional investment and public justification, making management inclined to persist despite the product's greater distance from the classic craft portfolio.
This seasonal electronic add-on received less prominent support than the core music-box line, so despite prior investment it is the easiest distant niche item for management to discontinue.
A themed Christmas pyramid extends a core product type, was shown on the home page, and matches the firm's traditional identity, so management would be reluctant to remove it.
